summary: Severe harvester shortage: 44 of 60 required (short 16, 12 after July hires); only 8.7 of 12 rounds done and intervals average 16 days (PA 2/2026).
Yield is weak: Agro shows Juasa B at 3.87 t/ha Jan–May (4.00 in 2025) and 9.73 t/ha for 2025, versus 17.42 for Juasa A; PA's 6.53 t/ha uses a 2,149.17 ha base that does not match Juasa B.
Flooding drives losses: 613.90 ha (40%) is flood-prone; PR22/T2 palms died after repeated plantings.
Fresh rat damage 22–30% in all young blocks with only one baiting round done and no barn owl boxes.
Manuring behind: 39% of the 2026 programme by May (Agro); Mix B and RP arrived late and were applied in July.

issues.title: PA crop figures do not match Juasa B
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 crop table uses 2,149.17 ha and reports 6.53 t/ha to June (7.20 same period 2025; 18.42 t/ha full 12 months last year). Juasa B mature area is 1,305.03 ha, and Agro 1/2026 Table 17 shows Juasa B at 3.87 t/ha Jan–May 2026 vs 4.00 in 2025, and its graph shows 9.73 t/ha for 2025. The PA crop table appears to cover a different area (possibly Juasa A+B) and should be confirmed.

issues.title: Cost of production budget column wrong
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 section 9: 'Estimate todate' general charges shows RM13.90/t (RM1,950,318 / 14,032.23 mt = RM138.99, so a dropped digit), and the total RM279.15 adds up the typo. The budget column divides budget RM by actual crop (14,032.23 mt) instead of budget crop (18,899 mt); the 'annual budget' column divides the full-year budget by year-to-date crop (e.g. RM3,900,590 / 14,032.23 = 277.97). Using the report's own budget amounts and 18,899 mt gives roughly RM300/t vs actual RM324.69/t. copBudget left null.

issues.title: Manuring progress differs
issues.detail: PA 2/2026: 48 of 66 rounds applied to June (73%). Agro 1/2026: 404.03 of 1,023.00 mt (39%) to May, with RP only 15% and Mix B 32%. Different dates and bases, but directors should not read 73% as tonnage done.

issues.title: PR22/T2 status contradicts
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 para 2.5: PR22/T2 redeclared PR22/TB, vacant, to be planted only after flooding is solved, yet still counted as 40.47 ha immature. Agro 1/2026 para 5.18 ('P24TB', 40.27 ha) says a fourth round of supply was recently completed, and the Agro 2026 programme fertilises 40.5 ha of T2 supply palms.

issues.title: Weeding progress text vs table
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 circle spraying: text says 625 ha, 27% of 2,343.9 ha; table totals 1,005.24 of 2,724.10 ha (37%). Selective: text 1,384 ha, 46% of 3,039 ha; table 1,764.27 of 3,419.03 ha (52%). Tables also include immature PR24 and PN22T2.

issues.title: Pruning text garbled
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 para 6.6.1 says '1145.47 ha out of 1077 ha' pruned; the table shows 1,145.47 ha of a 6,462.60 ha annual programme (18%).

issues.title: Palm stand (SPH) figures conflict
issues.detail: Agro 1/2026 Table 5 'current' SPH column totals 101 (e.g. 93F 113), but total palms / area gives 125 (191,478 / 1,532.2; 93F 24,146 / 201.6 = 120), and the text uses 125 SPH. Area also includes 126.7 ha new replant with no census.

issues.title: Fertiliser type differs
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 records NK1 applied in P99I and P15N; the Agro 1/2026 2026 programme specifies NK3 (40% SOA:60% MOP) for these blocks, while the Agro progress table still lists NK1 for Juasa B.

issues.title: Manuring table totals
issues.detail: PA 2/2026: PM22T table total shows 72.30 ha for each round, though its sub-blocks total 227.93 ha; PM99I round 2 done shows 207.00 ha (sub-blocks I1–I4 sum to 207.00, so only half the field).

issues.title: Immature area text vs table
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 para 2.2 says immature fell to 227.17 ha; area table shows 167.17 ha immature plus 60.00 ha replant (227.17 only if replant is included).

issues.title: Costs are Juasa A+B combined
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 says general charges, mature upkeep and capex cover both Juasa A and B, so the RM/ha and RM/t figures are not Juasa B alone.

issues.title: Bunch weight data doubtful
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 flags June 2025 vs June 2026 bunch weights: 2000 planting 4.4 to 15.2 kg, 2015 4.1 to 9.1 kg, 2020 9.3 to 6.6 kg; recording needs checking.

issues.title: Vehicle account totals garbled
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 section 11: totals row shows RM/km 2.93 actual vs 0.22 budget and budget figures 16,500.77 / 500.00 that do not follow from the vehicle lines (each Hilux 0.34–0.43 RM/km).

Construct camber bunds on 43 ha of the 2026 replant
Complete PR24 palm supplying and improve inter-row conditions
Comprehensive plan to fix prolonged flooding and high water table (incl. PR22/TB)

kb:
LADANG JUASA B - FACT PACK (Fleet Properties Sdn Bhd)
Sources: PA Report 2/2026 (Planting Advisor Mr. Boey Chee Weng, visit 28 July 2026, period Jan-June 2026) and Agronomy Report 1/2026 for Juasa A and B (Senior Agronomist Mr. Lai Hong Heng, visit 24-25 June 2026, data mostly to May 2026). Only Juasa B content is used here unless stated. General Manager Mr. Lee Chong Yew; Senior Manager Mr Chan Wah Vee (PA) / En. Mohd Shafirun (Agro lists him as Senior Manager and Mr Chan as Estate Manager); Estate Manager En. Shamsul Bin Mohammad Sahib. Assistants Salleh Nor, Saddam (joined Feb 2026) and Ismaaliff (joined Apr 2026) are new; PA says manager must train them.

AREA (PA 2/2026): Mature 1,305.03 ha (P93 F2-5 201.60; P97 H4 35.90; P99 I1-8 395.80; P00 J1-3 91.70; P04 L 40.30; P15 N1-4 207.40; P16 P1-2 66.20; P20 R4 38.20; PM22 T2-T6 227.93). Immature 167.17 ha (PN22 T2 40.47; PR24 V3 62.10; PR24 V4 64.60). Replanting 2026 60.00 ha (ex-P97H2/H3, now PR26/X5-X6). Roads/drains 1.00, office/housing 1.80, vacant plantable land needing cambered bunds 26.10. Total 1,621.10 ha. Mature rose from 1,137.10 ha as P22 was declared mature in 2026. Replanting plan: P99 I6/I7/I8 (PA says 188 ha) in 2027; Agro Table 6 says 2027 P99I5-I8 188.8 ha and 2028 P99I1-I4, P97H4, P00J1-J3 139.8 ha. PA: PR22/T2 redeclared PR22/TB, palms died after three plantings due to persistent flooding; vacant until flooding solved. Agro (calling it P24TB, 40.27 ha) says a fourth round of supply was recently completed. Agro blocking: Juasa B 10 blocks, 32 sub-blocks, 1,532.20 ha; age profile 0-3 yrs 395.1 ha (26%), 4-7 38.2 (2%), 8-19 273.6 (18%), 20-25 132.5 (9%), over 26 693.3 (45%). Palm census June 2025: 191,478 palms; text says average 125 SPH (Juasa A 138); Table 5 'current' column shows 113/109/103/104/119/111/122/134/130 by field and 101 overall. Agro: SPH is a main yield-limiting factor; assess infilling of P20R and P22T to 148 SPH; 450 palms supplied in 2026. Flood-prone area 613.90 ha (40% of estate) per Agro, worst in P99I3/I7/I8, P15N1-N4, P97H3, P00J1.

LABOUR (PA 2/2026, June 2026): Total 70 vs 88 required (short 18); ratio 1 worker to 19 ha, ideal 1:11. Harvesters 44 vs 60 required (1:30 ha actual vs 1:22 ha), short 16; 4 recruited in July, still short 12. Weeding 14 vs 17; manuring 7 vs 6; drivers/loaders 4/4; mandore 1/1. Field staff adequate, one field conductor post vacant.

CROP (PA 2/2026 crop table, to June 2026): hectarage shown 2,149.17; FFB 14,032.23 mt vs budget to date 18,899 mt (annual 37,446); same period last year 15,660.18 mt (12-month 40,080). Yield 6.53 t/ha vs budget 8.79 (26% below) and 7.20 last year (9% below); annual budget 17.42, last year full 18.42. CPO 2,298.64 mt, OER 16.38% vs 18.94% budget; kernel 5.00%. Note: the 2,149.17 ha base does not match Juasa B's 1,305.03 mature ha, and Agro shows much lower Juasa B yields (see issues). PA blames harvester shortage, flooding and low crop season. Bunch weights June 2025 vs June 2026: 1993 20.6 to 26.3 kg; 1997 20.2 to 19.5; 1999 19.5 to 19.7; 2000 4.4 to 15.2; 2004 9.5 to 16.6; 2015 4.1 to 9.1; 2016 9.2 to 8.2; 2020 9.3 to 6.6; 2022 2.5 to 3.6; PA wants the 2000, 2015 and 2020 differences investigated. Good fruit sets in P22/T5, P20/R4, P16/P1.
Agro 1/2026 Table 17 (Juasa B, Jan-May, t/ha 2025 vs 2026): total 4.00 to 3.87 on 1,365.03 ha (-3.25%). Large falls: 93F2 9.65 to 2.55; 99I4 11.12 to 4.97; 00J3 7.81 to 3.91; 20R4 8.63 to 5.19; 97H4 7.74 to 4.65. Gains: 22T2 0.54 to 5.67; 22T5 3.15 to 6.50; 22T6 2.28 to 5.08; 99I8 1.80 to 4.42. Full-year FFB yield (Agro graph): Juasa B 2021 13.12, 2022 13.37, 2023 11.96, 2024 14.48, 2025 9.73 t/ha; Juasa A 2025 17.42. Agro says Juasa B yield remains unsatisfactory, driven by old palms, low SPH and flooding.

HARVESTING: PA: 8.7 rounds to June vs 12 budgeted; average interval 16 days, target 14; harvester turnout 68% because flooded areas could not be harvested and harvesters were used for pruning. Only 1 Badang for in-field evacuation; wheelbarrows elsewhere; 9 Badangs planned. Output 1.50-2.00 t/manday, earnings RM70.30-132.00/day against basic RM65.39; harvest rates RM38-88/t paid vs RM47-99 budget. Agro: intervals Jan-May 2026 8-21 days (2025 was 9-108 days due to flooding). Harvest checks: P22T6 8% overripe; P22T5 5% overripe and 8% underripe; P99I5 16%; P99I4 16%; P99I8 13% overripe, called excessively high and unacceptable. Incomplete loose fruit collection in P99I1/I3. Harvesting and collection cost (PA, combined data): RM1,288,620, RM91.83/t vs RM87.97/t budget; top-up wages RM66,694 unbudgeted; PA notes the budget was spread evenly by month so comparisons are not accurate.

COSTS (PA 2/2026, June 2026, combined Juasa A and B): General charges RM1,347,116.32 = RM438.86/ha vs RM635.38/ha budget (31% under). Mature upkeep RM1,920,326 = RM893.50/ha vs RM958.21 (7% under): weeding 103.16 vs 128.98; manuring 666.63 vs 603.30; pest 13.89 vs 19.30; drains 28.35 vs 86.86; roads 43.27 vs 34.23; culverts 5.36 vs 5.63; soil/water 0.53 vs 17.82; pruning 31.64 vs 60.14; census 0 vs 1.95. Cost of production actual RM324.69/t FFB (GC 96.00, upkeep 136.85, harvest 91.83) and RM1,982.07/t CPO; the estimate column (GC 13.90, upkeep 146.76, harvest 118.49, total 279.15) is internally wrong, see issues. Capex budget RM6,000, spent RM3,600 (fibre boat, Jan 2026). Three Hilux vehicles; running cost judged satisfactory.

UPKEEP (PA 2/2026): Circle spraying: text says 625 ha (0.5 rounds), 27% of 2,343.9 ha budgeted; table shows 1,005.24 of 2,724.10 ha (37%). Delays from early-year flooding. CKS output 6.6 ha/day at RM15/ha (RM99/day); Glyphosate 0.24 kg/ha + Ally 0.02 kg/ha; advised to drop Ally and switch to Inter Pumps (ordered). Selective: text 1,384 ha (1.2 rounds), 46% of 3,039 ha; table 1,764.27 of 3,419.03 ha (52%). Mist blower 6 ha/day at RM16/ha (RM96/day) but only 7 pumps/day (4.6 hours worked) vs potential 11. Agro: Juasa B interrow round 1 82%, round 2 59%; circle round 1 56%; flood-prone sub-blocks skipped. Ground cover improved with soft grasses and Lindernia on peat; dense weeds in P22T4/T6, P20R4, P93F4; VOPs in P20R4; bare ground P15N1/N2. Manuring: PA 48 of 66 rounds applied to June; Mix B and RP delivered late and applied in July; 30 bags/day at RM2.30/bag (RM69/day). Agro to May: 404.03 of 1,023.00 mt (39%): Mix B 139.42 of 440.20 (32%), NK2 78.55 (100%), NK1 139.26 of 227.75 (61%), RP 32.00 of 210.20 (15%), compound 14.80 of 66.30 (22%). Agro also recorded 9,444 mt EFB on 236.10 ha in 2025 (P93F2, P93F3, P24V at 40 t/ha); no EFB in 2026 by May. 2026 programme (kg/palm): see block list; 2026/2027 replant blocks get no fertiliser; FY2026 programme must not run past January 2027. Pruning (PA): progressive 1,145.47 ha of 6,462.60 ha annual programme (18%); corrective backlog 110.57 ha, 16.45 done, 94.12 balance. Agro: pruning improved but low completion due to pruner shortage; runt palms in P99I8, P04L, P16P not yet removed; epiphytes in P04L (poisoning started June), P00J1/J2. Roads 1,769 of 1,960 chains graded at RM19/chain. Drains: desilted 278 chains of 12x8x6 (budget 200) and 387 of 30x12x10 (budget 450). Agro: 1,697 chains desilted in 2025 and 650 more by May 2026; water control in collection drains poor (P16P1, P15N4 waterlogged); keep water table 50-80 cm; culverts lowered in P16P2 and P04L on 10-11 July.

PESTS (PA and Agro agree): fresh rat damage May 2026 P04L 22%, P15N 27%, P16P 22%, P20R 30%, P22T 23%. One baiting round done (P22T round 2 at 50%); continue until below 10%; census every 3 months. Juasa B has no barn owl boxes; Agro says install in stages. PR24: 12 rounds cypermethrin for Oryctes; 480 palms supplied. Ganoderma census not yet done for replant blocks; use Ganoderma SOP if infection above 10%.

IMMATURE AND REPLANT (PA): PR24 V3-V4 126.7 ha cost RM116,863 to date (RM922/ha vs RM1,126 budget); cumulative RM1,185,731 (RM9,359/ha). Circle and selective spraying 3 of 3 rounds, manuring 2 of 2 rounds. PR26 X5-X6 60 ha: RM48,520 spent vs RM393,180 budget to date; felling and chipping from June; 43 ha need camber bunds. Agro: land preparation from mid-August 2026; consider 160 SPH on peat; install piezometers; compact peat on bunds; remove all polybags.

RAINFALL (Agro): average annual 2,827 mm with about 12 rainy days a month, about 18 effective working days a month; June averages about 153 mm. No year-by-year record for Juasa B in either report.
